tasks.label: ▶︎  Start the site  →  localhost:8123
tasks.detail: Starts the local server and opens the site in your browser. Leave the panel open while you work.
tasks.command: python3 -m http.server 8123 & sleep 1 && open http://localhost:8123 && wait

tasks.label: ■  Stop the site
tasks.detail: Shuts down the local server running on port 8123.
tasks.command: PIDS=$(lsof -ti tcp:8123); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then kill $PIDS; echo 'Server stopped.'; else echo 'Nothing was running on 8123.'; fi

tasks.label: ↻  Open the site in the browser
tasks.detail: Opens localhost:8123. Start the site first if it is not already running.

tasks.label: 📱  Show the address for my phone
tasks.detail: Prints the Wi-Fi address to open the site on a phone or tablet on the same network.
tasks.command: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1); echo ''; echo "  Open this on your phone:  http://$IP:8123"; echo ''

tasks.label: 🚀  Publish to the web  (makes the site public)
tasks.detail: Deploys to Vercel and gives you a permanent address. Opens a browser to sign in the first time. You can press Enter on every question.

tasks.label: ⬆︎  Save my changes to GitHub
tasks.detail: Commits everything and pushes to the private repository.
tasks.command: git add -A && git commit -m "${input:commitMessage}" && git push && echo '' && echo '  Pushed to https://github.com/rut1001/foz-atlantica'
